verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a SaaS expense platform like Expensify, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows an HTTP Integration Server API with credentials, OAuth, and natural-language in-app AI. The GitHub items are npm scripts and dev skills for building and testing Expensify's own app repo, not a user-facing official CLI, so none of this counts toward the story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
